Overview.Name: Manikanta Swamy Kalyani
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction

Meal_1: Option 2: RICE RAWA upma (small) & paneer cubes (60 g)
Option 3: Vegetable poha (1 medium bowl) with peanuts (1 tbsp) (lighter option)
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (80 g) & vegetable curry
Option 2: 2 chapati & paneer curry (80 g) & salad
Option 3: Vegetable khichdi (1 bowl) & curd (small cup) (lighter option)
Meal_3: Option 1: Clear vegetable soup (1 large bowl) & paneer cubes (60 g)

Notes_and_Tips: Because your routine is fixed and late nights are a trigger, keep dinner light and avoid fried snacks after work.
For better physique focus, make paneer and dal the main portion and keep rice or chapati moderate.
If fried cravings come, choose pan cooked paneer instead of deep fried foods.
Try to finish dinner at least 2 hours before sleep to improve recovery and energy.
Simple home style cooking will help you stay consistent even with long work hours.
